name: bugpilot-ai
description: BugPilot AI — Your AI QA Engineer

scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ai,worker -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service" "npm run worker -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w automation && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w automation && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test --prefix ai-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
